title: Successful login with valid credentials
steps: Enter email test@qabrains.com in email field
Enter password Password123 in password field
expected: User is redirected to the home/product page after successful login

title: Login with wrong password
steps: Enter email test@qabrains.com in email field
Enter password WrongPass123 in password field
expected: Error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials

title: Login with unregistered email
steps: Enter email unknown@test.com in email field
Enter password Password123 in password field
expected: Error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials

title: Login with empty email field
steps: Enter password Password123 in password field
expected: Validation error message for required email field

title: Login with empty password field
steps: Enter email test@qabrains.com in email field
expected: Validation error message for required password field

title: Login with both fields empty
expected: Validation error messages for both required fields

title: Login with SQL injection in email field
steps: Enter SQL injection payload in email field
Enter any password in password field
expected: Login fails, no unauthorized access, error message displayed

title: Login with XSS payload in email field
steps: Enter XSS payload in email field
expected: No script execution, payload is sanitized or escaped

title: Login with email containing only spaces
steps: Enter password Password123 in password field
expected: Validation error or login fails, spaces are trimmed

title: Login with very long email address
testData: Email: a very long string (256+ chars) @test.com, Password: Password123
steps: Enter very long email in email field
Enter password Password123 in password field
expected: Email field handles max length gracefully, no crash

title: Password visibility toggle functionality
steps: Click eye/toggle button next to password field
expected: Password toggles between visible and hidden states

title: Verify login page elements are present
expected: All login page elements are present and visible

title: Login with email missing @ symbol
steps: Enter invalid email without @ in email field
Enter password Password123 in password field
expected: Validation error for invalid email format

title: Login with Enter key instead of button click
steps: Enter valid email in email field
Enter valid password in password field
expected: Login is submitted and user is redirected

title: Login with SQL injection in password field
steps: Enter valid email in email field
Enter SQL injection in password field
